changes.comment: Test-only: fix the flaky "can set computation" property. It predicted a Value notification from whether the two generated arrays differed, but the subscribed control holds the computation's *result*, so the notification follows whether the result changed — [0] and [] are different arrays with the same sum. Expectations are now derived from the actual values (including the initial -1, which a sum can equal), and the replaceCompute(max) transition is asserted too rather than left unchecked. Measured 2 failures in 25 runs before, 0 in 60 after.
